phrases.text: Welcome to Tiki Tiki Lounge & Bar,
phrases.tts: Welcome to Tiki Tiki Lounge and Bar,

phrases.text: a tropical restaurant and lounge planned for Pacific Beach, San Diego.
Picture warm wood, glowing lights, an ocean breeze, and a central tiki bar.
We'll walk you through our concept, guests, menus, financials, and team.
Our concept combines coastal, Baja-influenced food,
creative tropical cocktails,
live entertainment, and a relaxed social atmosphere.
What makes it distinctive is the whole experience in one place.
We believe Pacific Beach fits, because its beach lifestyle and social energy suit a fun, tropical concept.
Inside, a large island-style tiki bar anchors the room, so guests gather from every side.
Warm wood finishes, tropical decor, and lush greenery set the mood.
Comfortable booths suit groups,
a small stage hosts live music,
and an outdoor patio opens it all to the coastal air.
Our primary target market is adults ages 21 to 35.
phrases.tts: Our primary target market is adults ages twenty-one to thirty-five.

phrases.text: We expect college students and young adults, young professionals, couples on dates,
groups of friends, local San Diego residents, and tourists.
These are target-market assumptions, not verified statistics.
Our guests enjoy socializing, attractive tropical spaces, and memorable dining and nightlife.
They want creative drinks, distinctive food, live music, outdoor seating, and places worth sharing.
Casual gatherings, date nights, and nights out all fit,
because our space, menu, and drinks are built for time together.
Appetizers are built for sharing.

Our food strategy is coastal and Baja-inspired, built on seafood and fresh flavors.
Chicken, steak, burgers, and rice bowls add variety,
and tropical fruit and coconut appear throughout.

phrases.text: Now, the bar.
Seven signature cocktails use rum, tequila, mezcal, and bourbon with mango, pineapple, passion fruit, and guava.
They are the clearest expression of our tropical identity.
Alcohol is served responsibly, only to guests 21 and over, in line with our licensing requirements.

phrases.text: That isn't verified profit, and repairs, marketing, supplies, waste, and taxes are missing.
A general manager leads our proposed team.
A head chef leads line and prep cooks and dish support.
Bartenders run the central bar, while servers, hosts, and bussers or runners care for guests.
Musicians are booked as needed.
Skilled, well-scheduled staff protect service, food quality, guest satisfaction, and profit.
We'll recruit through culinary schools, job boards, referrals, and local networks,
and hire with clear job descriptions, structured interviews, skill tests, and references,
then train menus, food safety, service, teamwork, safety, and responsible alcohol service.
Fair schedules, respect, cross-training, and growth keep them.
